name: Starfish
description: An extensive format with five columns that shows how much to do more or less of, instead of just yes or no. Good when the team wants a detailed look.

columns.name: Keep doing
columns.prompt: What works well and should stay exactly as it is?

columns.name: Less of
columns.prompt: What do we do too much of and should reduce?

columns.name: More of
columns.prompt: What helps us and should we do more often?

columns.name: Start doing
columns.prompt: What new thing should we try?

mood.neutral: Enough energy is needed for five columns.

goal.reflect-period: A detailed look at the whole period.
goal.reflect-project: Gives precise guidance for the project.

checkInQuestion: What is one thing you would like to do more of this week?
facilitationTips: Show all five columns and explain the difference between Less of and Stop doing.
Ask people to fill every column, even with a small note.
Vote on the three notes to discuss so the extra columns do not eat the time.
